title: Coadjoint averaging and cross-scale fluxes in a fast-slow stochastic Euler-Arnold system on $SU(N)$
summary: We study the emergence of (cross-scale) fluxes associated with energy and enstrophy in a stochastic version of Zeitlin's $SU(N)$ approximation of 2-d Euler dynamics. Motivated by the Euler-Arnold formulation, we interpret the nonlinear transport as motion along coadjoint orbits, reflecting an underlying symmetry that preserves all Casimir invariants. We introduce a fast-slow stochastic framework in which rapid mixing is modeled by a structured fast stochastic forcing acting along selected directions.
